title: Aura particle
description: A fully customizable particle aura and trail mod for Minecraft 1.21!
body:
A fully customizable particle aura and trail mod for Minecraft 1.21.8!
 Warped
- **Movement Styles** - Rotation, Pulsing, Floating, Spiral, Waves
- **Trail Effect** - Particles follow you when walking
- **First-Person Optimized** - Can be hidden in first-person view
- **Multiplayer Compatible** - Other players with the mod see your aura. (comming soon )
- **Fully Configurable** - Open menu with R key
- **This is my first mod. Please don't expect anything huge.**
- **thx for using This mod <3**

PRESS  **R** TO OPEN THE GUI
